changelog:
honcho-setup 1.0.4

- Clarified that data upload via `openclaw honcho setup` always requires explicit interactive user confirmation, even when `HONCHO_API_KEY` is set.
- Updated documentation to warn that, after setup, the plugin persistently observes conversations and transmits data to Honcho on an ongoing basis.
- Expanded instructions on disabling the plugin to stop ongoing data transmission.
- No changes to files or core functionality; documentation only.
